relations.reading: A reframing intervention may change both the formal representation of work and the operating flow subsequently used to evaluate it.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: Independent dependency and attribution records provide a concrete comparison for the distinction between found flow and declared representation.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: Cross-frame coherence is assessed against an independently specified upstream outcome, making the map–flow argument operational without equating every deviation with value.

relations.title: Information Management as Operational Tracking
relations.reading: Operational tracking can close the loop between a process representation and the effects of decisions taken through it, rather than treating the diagram as a static description.

relations.title: JubAp.Net Distributed Tiger Team Model – origins –
relations.reading: Embedded field architecture can shorten corrective feedback between the operational flow and the representation used to change it.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.

relations.title: Narrativa, centro y frontera: por qué los modelos simples fallan cuando llega la implementación
relations.reading: Narrative compression becomes operationally consequential when the simplified model is used as the control surface for decisions that depend on omitted conditions.

relations.title: Structural Awareness Programme
relations.reading: The preserved September synthesis records an earlier programme reading of the map–flow problem; its dated status should remain visible beside the current explanation.

relations.title: Programme Bridge Note — Map, Flow, Epistemic Distance and the Lineage to Ecosystem Positioning
relations.reading: The programme bridge extends the map–flow reading while keeping analytical closure distinct from causal isolation and its provisional topology separate from established results.

relations.reading: A certificate sufficient for one request need not remain sufficient when simultaneous requests consume the same underlying capacity.
